bullets.id: Emas anjlok pada Kamis: Kitco mencatat emas di sekitar $4.021,20 pada sore hari, turun $119,10 atau 2,88%, dan perak turun 5,90% ke sekitar $54,44. Vibiznews mencatat emas spot ditutup di $4.024,44, terendah sejak Agustus, setelah menembus $4.100 dan support $4.073. Kitco menyebut penurunan ini menghapus seluruh kenaikan sejak musim panas.
bullets.en: Gold slumped on Thursday: Kitco had gold near $4,021.20 in the afternoon, down $119.10 or 2.88%, and silver down 5.90% at about $54.44. Vibiznews says spot gold closed at $4,024.44, the lowest since August, after breaking $4,100 and the $4,073 support. Kitco says the drop erased all of the gains since the summer.

bullets.id: Pemicunya ketegangan baru di Selat Hormuz yang mendorong Brent di atas $113 dan WTI mendekati $100, serta aksi jual saham AI: Nasdaq turun 2,60% dan S&P 500 turun 1,21%. Yield Treasury justru turun, tetapi tidak menahan emas, tanda tekanan likuidasi. Peluang kenaikan Fed Desember sekitar 89–94%. Emas sekitar 28% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dan turun sekitar 5,9% sebulan.
bullets.en: The triggers were renewed Strait of Hormuz tension, which pushed Brent above $113 and WTI toward $100, and a selloff in AI stocks: the Nasdaq fell 2.60% and the S&P 500 1.21%. Treasury yields actually fell but did not hold gold up, a sign of liquidation. The odds of a December Fed hike are about 89–94%. Gold is about 28% below its $5,608.35 record and down about 5.9% on the month.

bullets.id: Level dari Kitco: resistance $4.068 dan $4.079, lalu $4.124,25; support $4.038 lalu area $4.000. Vibiznews melihat support spot $3.983–$3.942 dan resistance $4.103–$4.182. Klaim pengangguran turun ke 194.000, di bawah perkiraan 200.000. Agenda: PMI awal Oktober dan sentimen konsumen final (Jumat), rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober, lalu PCE September pada 29 Oktober.
bullets.en: Kitco’s levels: resistance at $4,068 and $4,079, then $4,124.25; support at $4,038, then the $4,000 area. Vibiznews sees spot support at $3,983–$3,942 and resistance at $4,103–$4,182. Jobless claims fell to 194,000, below the 200,000 forecast. Agenda: preliminary October PMIs and final consumer sentiment (Friday), the October 27–28 Fed meeting, then September PCE on October 29.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp10.000 ke Rp2.540.000/gram, penurunan hari keempat, sementara buyback anjlok Rp30.000 ke Rp2.335.000, sehingga spread melebar ke sekitar 8,1%. Galeri24 turun ke Rp2.499.000 (buyback Rp2.354.000, spread sekitar 5,8%) dan UBS ke Rp2.524.000 (buyback Rp2.328.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Buyback Galeri24 kini Rp19.000 di atas Antam.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp10,000 to Rp2,540,000/gram, a fourth daily decline, while buyback dropped Rp30,000 to Rp2,335,000, widening the spread to about 8.1%. Galeri24 fell to Rp2,499,000 (buyback Rp2,354,000, spread about 5.8%) and UBS to Rp2,524,000 (buyback Rp2,328,000, spread about 7.8%). Galeri24’s buyback is now Rp19,000 above Antam’s.
